report: doc_master ID migration with UI compatibility (PR D batch 2)
based_on: PR #160 fixed only the G-1 stale page anchor and deferred the doc_master ID migration due to frontend rendering risk. This PR performs the coordinated migration with index.html DOC_DICT compatibility.
disclaimer: Internal audit artifact. Not legal advice and not an official immigration decision.

compressed_archive_verification.decision: Proceeded using committed repo files only. Canonical PDFs and source_manifest.json were not touched (PR #155 scope, closed).

scope_statement: Coordinated migration of the 12 corrupted Korean-string doc_master IDs to stable machine-readable IDs, with index.html DOC_DICT compatibility so rendering is byte-identical. No required-document meanings changed; no requiredDocuments added or removed; no eligibility/fees/income/stay-periods/procedures/legal-admin text rewritten; no verified=true promotions; no needsManualReview removals; no records deleted; no visual/layout/UX/search/AI changes.

Near-duplicate dedupe (if ever desired) is deferred.
